card.name: Last digit of a year after 'In'
card.fires_on: Mostly the final digit of a year (like 1883, 324, 1904) in a historical sentence beginning 'In'. Also fires on the word right after a sentence-opening 'In', 'To' or a place name, as in 'In person'.

modes.label: Year's last digit
modes.description: The last digit of a four-digit or three-digit year starting a historical sentence.
modes.example: In 188<<3>> Kautsky founded and edited the Marxist

modes.label: Word after sentence-opening preposition
modes.description: A word right after a short opening phrase like 'In' or 'To' at the start of a sentence.
modes.example: Of course, she too was religious, and intensely so, breathing as she did the intoxicating air of Transcendentalism. In<< person>> she described herself as small, like the

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward a clause-starting connective or subject, such as Chinese linking words, but the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the last digit of a year in historical writing, just before the sentence says what happened then.
